text:
alex_support: Hey team — TeresA from Acme reported sudden p95 spikes and an increase in 429 throttles on their Dedicated pool (eu-west-1). Customer sees increased token usage and timeouts starting ~09:10 UTC. Any quick triage pointers?
teresa_acme: Yep — noticed response latencies jump from ~120ms to 1.2s, and a handful of requests returned 429s. Not changed our traffic pattern. See our sample trace: 
```
req_id: 9f3a7
model: gpt-medium-8k
start: 2026-03-15T09:09:58Z
end: 2026-03-15T09:10:04Z
status: 429 then 200
latencies: [118ms, 120ms, 124ms, 1220ms, 125ms]
```
omar_sre: Thanks. Two likely suspects: 1) MIG sibling contention on the host 2) autoscaler temporarily throttled their burst due to slot exhaustion. I can check node-level metrics — can you share the tenant allocation id?
teresa_acme: alloc-ACME-77
priya_platform: Pulling allocation mapping now. Querying placement: `redwoodctl allocations get alloc-ACME-77 --region eu-west-1 --output json`
priya_platform: Got host info: host-49a2 (A100-SXM4), MIG config: 3g.1g.6g slices (two tenants on same physical GPU).
omar_sre: That's suspicious—other tenant on same GPU has a bursty batch job earlier around 09:09. Asking mig_monitor_bot to show per-slice SM util and memory bandwidth.
mig_monitor_bot: Per-slice stats (09:05-09:15 UTC):
```
host: host-49a2
slice-A (alloc-ACME-77): sm_util p50=18% p95=42%
slice-B (alloc-OTHER-33): sm_util p50=12% p95=89%
mem_bw p95 slice-B=95%
KV cache hit ratio slice-A=82% slice-B=13%
```
omar_sre: Looks like slice-B had a transient high SM and memory bandwidth usage — likely large batched workload causing L3 thrashing. That can spike latency for neighboring slices even with MIG.
alex_support: Could the runtime batching or KV cache locks exacerbate this? Any chance of global kernel contention?
raj_infra: Yes. Even with MIG, shared PCIe/NVLink fabric and L3/cache can raid performance. Also if slice-B is doing intense multi-stream workloads it can saturate L2/L3 and memory controller. Check process-level metrics: `nvidia-smi dmon` and `nvprof` traces would help, but we only get per-slice telemetry from host.
priya_platform: Also saw autoscaler events: `autoscale-controller bumped to 0->1 for alloc-ACME-77 at 09:08:56 then rolled back at 09:10:05 due to slot-provision-failed` — so the system attempted to add capacity but hit packing fragmentation. That explains 429s during the rollback.
teresa_acme: Ouch — so two issues coinciding. Is there a recommended mitigation for the customer now?
omar_sre: Short-term: 1) Move alloc-ACME-77 to a different host (evacuate to host-63) or 2) schedule a manual burst cap increase (temporary reserved slot bump) to avoid autoscale race. I'll propose moving.
priya_platform: I can trigger `redwoodctl allocations migrate alloc-ACME-77 --target-host host-63` — host-63 has similar GPU type and currently low load. Approving migration will cause ~200-400ms soft reconnection for in-flight streams.
teresa_acme: Prefer minimal impact — what's the expected downtime and cost?
raj_infra: Migration is live routing change; some in-flight requests might retry automatically. Expected client-visible blips up to 1s across a few requests. No extra billing beyond standard egress/compute for that host. If they'd rather avoid migration, we can enable a temporary dedicated reservation for 1 hour.
alex_support: Can we also add a short-term guard to avoid colocating batchy tenants with latency-sensitive ones? Maybe a soft affinity label?
priya_platform: We have placement tags. I'll add `latency-sensitive=true` to alloc-ACME-77 and adjust the placement policy to avoid hosts with known high batch activity for next 2 hours.
mig_monitor_bot: Note: host-49a2 shows L3 evict events spike at 09:09:30 -> 09:10:10. That aligns with reported window.
omar_sre: Action items: 1) Priya migrate to host-63 now (if ops ok) 2) Raj to check if slice-B owner can be rate-limited/evicted for a graceful backoff 3) Alex to notify customer of short blip and mitigation plan.
raj_infra: Reached out to owner of alloc-OTHER-33 asking to throttle down scheduled batch for 10m.
priya_platform: Migration started at 09:13 UTC. Will monitor p95 for next 20m.
mig_monitor_bot: Migration completed 09:13:46. New host metrics (host-63): slice-A sm_util p95=35% mem_bw p95=32% KV cache hit=85%.
teresa_acme: Post-migration p95 back to ~130ms, no 429s in the last 7 minutes. Thanks.
alex_support: Great. For follow-up: propose (a) placement affinity tweaks, (b) autoscaler heuristics to prefer horizontal expansion before rollback, and (c) detection alert for per-slice mem_bw p95 > 70% to auto-evacuate noisy siblings. I'll open a product ticket. :thumbsup:
priya_platform: Filed PROD-8462 with summary and timeline.
omar_sre: Let's also add a short KB note for support on steps: check mig_monitor_bot, verify autoscale events, consider migrate or temporary reservation.
teresa_acme: Appreciate the quick help. Will monitor and report if anything else pops up. :wave:
